pages.text: The personal key is used to take ownership of drawers, which locks them to the owning player.$(p)layers can't interact with blocks owned by another player, though they can still break them.$(p)Variations of this key exist to allow team-based ownership.
The CoFH personal key locks drawers to your CoFH friends list.  Any players on your friends list will also be able to interact with your owned blocks.
The FTB personal key locks drawers to your FTB team.  Any players on your team list will also be able to interact with your owned blocks.

The admin personal key is a creative-obtainable item that can unlock any owned block.$(p)This can be used by server ops to help a player that gets locked out of their own drawers if, for example, their user ID changes.
